description: Offset given as east / north components on a direction (radians from north, clockwise), as the SMR accuracy splits an offset into radial / tangential (direction = azimuth) and along / across (direction = heading). Direction 90 deg (east): 30 m east is 30 m along, 20 m north is 20 m to the left (across -20). Direction 180 deg (south): 10 m south is 10 m along, 5 m east is 5 m to the left.
